scenario.name: Synthetic Cabin Safety Demo
scenario.description: Deterministic synthetic dataset for demonstrating the MultiSens v0.4 requirement profile and coverage workflow end to end, across multiple illumination/occlusion conditions. Ground truth and predictions are both generated, not measured - see examples/profiles/README.md. Does NOT represent real sensor performance or any regulatory result.
